title: feat(nm2frm1sz): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along -e3 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: The band's constructor. Defines the cyclic frame F=(m,o_next,o_prev) from the 1-in/2-out split, Orient=det F, and transport P=F(dst)F(src)^T, then reports HOLD/HOLD for the -e3 1-step at all four seeds. I reproduced every number (tick<=1 count 14, all four frames, all four P matrices). DEFECT: edge_status's two post-conditions — 'P is a signed permutation' and 'det P = Orient(src)Orient(dst)' — are structural always-pass gates; I checked all 48x48=2304 frame pairs and found 0 counterexamples, so 'transport HOLDs' means exactly 'both endpoint frames are defined' and P never enters a verdict. Its mutation-lex-largest-uses-minus gate is likewise tautological in its 'differs' clause (flipping one column always flips det: 0/48 counterexamples).
